svg.title: Production on Proxmox: one node, one VM per role, every VM with its size, job and ports, in one image
svg.text: How our production runs: one node, one VM per role. Copy it.
One Proxmox machine holds every VM
HTTPS out: no VPN, no port opened
Fixed addresses: the VM id is the last number of its address.
Debian 12 (Langfuse: Debian 13), CPU x86-64-v2-AES, start on boot
Our production VMs: 22 vCPU, 37 GB RAM, about 800 GB of disk.
Inside the node, on the private bridge
Install the VMs in this order
cards and IR to device VMs
copy its 4 keys to server and
every VM each night, off site,
each VM has its own data disk:
grow the disk, not the VM
Hosts for real TVs and boxes are a Raspberry Pi or mini PC at each site, not VMs.
